user_query: I'm a gaming enthusiast and I want to discover new meme templates related to Fortnite. Fetch the latest news from the Epic Games store and provide me with meme templates. Additionally, suggest some popular meme fonts to make the memes more captivating.

TaskList.description: Fetch the latest news from the Epic Games store related to Fortnite.
Retrieve meme templates related to Fortnite based on the latest news.
Suggest popular meme fonts that can be used to create memes.
